scope: independent local business memory study; not old Skill Pair/Gate or official benchmark score
selection: input/task structural inspection before any study model execution; formula-free, bounded ranges; formation duplicate extraction and conditional update; transfer partial-column compaction, grouped sum and exception-aware deduplication
memory_override_location: dedicated research Proxy, not nanobot history; no change to EVALUATION_V1 guards
delivery_suffix: Preserve all data and formatting outside the requested transformation. Stop after verifying the saved output. Use literal computed values, not new Excel formulas, because this host does not provide formula recalculation.

formation.empty_result: retain; no curated replacement or prompt tuning

recall.scope: same isolated team/user/agent, omit task/session filters for cross-task history
recall.query: spreadsheet Excel openpyxl workbook rows columns
recall.frequency: once per fresh memory-arm session; same cached block on each model request
recall.zero_hits: valid no-exposure result, not evidence of memory benefit

snapshot: all L1 rows after both formation sessions complete; no selection/rewrite based on transfer tasks or results; reject unexpected sources
oracle: frozen workbook_oracle.py v1 specified-cell value comparison; formatting and non-target changes are separate audits

research_evidence.quality: at least one newly_fixed, zero newly_broken across all three tasks
research_evidence.cost: aggregate tokens/tool/model calls each <= 1.20 times no-memory; formation cost separately reported
research_evidence.interpretation: small exploratory study, not statistical proof or Promotion
research_evidence.probes: only on discordant pair or either arm reaching >=90% of call budget; 2 additional repetitions per arm for affected cases; keep main; no best-of

retry: implementation fix gets independent attempt and provenance; never overwrite
